questions.q_en: A and B can do a work alone in 40 days and 60 days respectively. They started the work together and B left 10 days before the completion of work. For how many days did B work?
questions.solution_en:
No. of days in which A can do the work alone = 40 days

No. of days in which B can do the work alone = 60 days

When A and B started the work together, B left 10 days before the completion of work. This means A alone worked for last 10 days. So,

Part of work done by A in last 10 days = 10/40 = 1/4

Remaining work = 1 - 1/4 = 3/4

Now, time taken by A and B together to complete 3/4th part of the work

= (3/4) * 1/(1/40 + 60)

= (3/4) * 1/((3 + 2)/120)

= (3/4) * 120/5

= 18

Therefore, B worked for 18 days.

questions.q_en: If the father's age 12 years ago was four times the age of his son and 10 years hence son's age will be a year less than half of the father's age, then find the ratio of their present ages.
questions.solution_en:
Let the present age of the son be 'a' years.

Age of the father 12 years ago = Age of the son 12 years ago * 4

=> Age of the father 12 years ago = (a - 12) * 4

Age of father 10 years hence = (Age of Son 10 years hence + 1) * 2

According to question,

(a -12) * 4 + 12 + 10 = (a + 10 + 1) * 2

=> 4a - 48 + 22 = 2a + 22

=> 2a = 48

=> a = 24

Father's present age = (24 - 12) * 4 + 12 = 60

Hence, the required ratio = 60/24 = 5: 2

questions.q_en: In alloys A and B, the ratio of lead to tin is 7: 4 and 4: 5, respectively. 220 kg of alloy A and 270 kg of alloy B are mixed to form a new alloy. What is the amount of tin (in kg) in the new alloy?
questions.solution_en:
Tin in alloy A = 220 * 4/(7 + 4) = 80 kg

Tin in alloy B = 270 * 5/(4 + 5) = 150 kg

Hence, the required amount = 80 + 150 = 230 kg

questions.q_en: Three runners Roshan, Rupesh, and Rishu run a race, with Roshan finishing 120 metres ahead of Rupesh and 240 metres ahead of Rishu. In another race of the same length, Rupesh finished 140 meters ahead of Rishu. Each runner travels the entire distance at a constant speed. Find the length of the race.
questions.solution_en:
Let the length of the race be 'D' meters

When Roshan travelled a distance of D meters, then Rupesh travelled (D - 120) meters and Rishu travelled (D - 240) meters.

When Rupesh travelled D meters, then Rishu travelled (D - 140) meters

Comparing both scenarios of Rupesh and Rishu

(D - 120)/(D - 240) = D/(D - 140)

D2 - 140D - 120D + 16800 = D2 - 240D

20D = 16800

D = 840 meters

questions.q_en: What is the area (in cm2) of the triangle having sides in the ratio 3: 2: 4 respectively and perimeter 36 cm?
questions.solution_en:
Perimeter = 36 cm

Then, first side = 36 * 3/9 = 12 cm

Second side = 36 * 2/9 = 8 cm

Third side = 36 * 4/9 = 16 cm

Perimeter/2 = 36/2 = 18 cm

Therefore, area = √(18 * (18 - 12) * (18 - 8) * (18 - 16))

= 12√15 cm2

questions.q_en: The cost of a diamond varies directly as the square of its weight. Once, this diamond broke into four pieces with weights in the ratio of 4 : 3 : 2 : 1 .When the pieces were sold, the merchant got ₹63,000 less than that of one piece. Find the original price of the diamond.
questions.solution_en:
Let weight of diamond be Y,

Here cost of diamond ∝ Y2

So cost of diamond= mY2

Here m is a constant.

The weight of four parts are in the ratio:- 4 : 3 : 2 : 1

So the four parts are 4x,3x,2x and x respectively.

Y=4x+3x+2x+x=10x

So cost of all parts individually=

For 4x:-

Cost=m(4x)2=16x2*m

For 3x:-

Cost=9x2*m

For 2x:-

Cost=4x2*m

For x:-

Cost=x2*m

Total=16x2*m + 9x2*m + 4x2*m + x2*m=30x2*m

Total cost of whole diamond= (10x)2*m=100x2*m

So, 100x2*m - 30x2*m=63000

70x2*m=63000

x2m=900

So 100x2m=90000.

Option (c) is the correct answer.

questions.q_en: Two pipes P and Q can fill the tank in 15 minutes and 12 minutes respectively. If both the pipes are opened alternately for 1 minute, starting with P, then in how much time will the tank be filled completely?
questions.solution_en:
Part of the tank filled by pipe P in a minute = 1/15

Part of the tank filled by pipe Q in a minute = 1/12

Part fill by P and Q in 2 minutes = 1/15 + 1/12 = 9/60 = 3/20

Part filled in 12 minutes = 6*3/20 = 9/10

Remaining Part = 1 - 9/10 = 1/10

Part of the tank filled by pipe P in 1.5 minutes = 1.5*1/15 = 1/10

Hence, total time = 12 + 1.5 = 13.5 minutes

An alloy contains the metals gold, silver, and zinc in the ratio 9: 5: 7, and another contains the metals silver, zinc, and tin in the ratio 11: 18: 13. If equal weights of each alloys are mixed to form a third alloy, then how many parts of the metal zinc is in the new alloy?
questions.solution_en:
Gold: Silver: Zinc = 9: 7: 5

Silver: Zinc: tin = 11: 18: 13

Let the quantity mixed from both alloys be '42' kg

Zinc in alloy 1st = 42 * 7/(9 + 7 + 5) = 14 kg

Zinc in alloy 2nd = 42 * 18/(11 + 18 + 13) = 18 kg

Hence, zinc in 3rd alloy = (14 + 18)/(42 + 42) = 8/21 kg
